Ruling: representation; i4562 pp. 13-15, Part V, and the items of the screen. The reply's screen differs from the project's only where the interview does not ask or where the project refuses elsewhere: (1) it refuses a 2025 vehicle answering No to scveh.bonus_same even with no allowance claimed; the interview asks bonus_same only where the allowance is claimed and the project refuses a mixed class election on the claiming entry (scveh.bonus_full, scveh.bonus_forty, and asset's lines), i4562 p. 7, Election out, "You can elect, for any class of property, to not deduct any special allowance for all such property in such class" (stage14.veh.2025_mq_nobonus: bonus_same unasked, project false, reply true); (2) vehicles placed in service before 2019, which the project refuses at column (d) (scveh.too_old; stage14.veh.refuse_too_old); (3) scveh.employee_use, which the project refuses at scveh.operating_business; (4) the parent-gated items (prior_bonus, prior_smr and prior_low_use only for an earlier vehicle; used_before and bonus_excluded only with an allowance; leasing, exempt_use and qbu_low only if others use the vehicle; acquired_before_bonus_date only for a 2025 vehicle), which the reply reads directly. The reply limits the screen to owned vehicles on actual expenses; the project's screen is read only through the depreciation lines of those vehicles. Triage executable-triage-v2 (pass b03568771f62; 1,986 fixtures, 500 generated returns, seed 20261026): 3,226/5,540 agree; 898 candidate-unknown, 823 project-unknown, 510 project-refuses, 83 value; on completed returns: 40 value, 26 candidate-unknown, 16 project-unknown, 12 project-refuses.

Both sides compute cost times the business-use percentage; the value differences are the percentage's rounding: the project uses business miles over total miles rounded half-up to six places (amb.2025.vehicle_business_pct, owner's ruling), where the reply rounds to four (stage18.mut.classm_f8962_4_nov_start $13,576.58 / $13,576.90; generated 402 $48,170.33 / $48,169.34). Triage records the reply's line hidden for owned vehicles on actual expenses that are not passenger automobiles (stage14.veh.suv_179, heavy_prior, heavy_2019): the reply limits the worksheet to passenger automobiles, while the project carries the same arithmetic for those vehicles through these lines (i4562 pp. 14-16, Part V, columns (d) to (i)); display only (representation). Candidate-unknown records withhold screen children the interview asks only under their parent (leasing, exempt_use, qbu_low under others_use; acquired_before_bonus_date, used_before, bonus_excluded under their parents), which the reply reads directly (representation); project refusals are cited (scveh.s179_bad, scveh.screened, scveh.too_old). Same as the landing round.
